Limitations
The study involved a small number of participants (four students and two teachers) from a single special needs school,
which limits the generalizability of the results. The focus on a single science topic—magnetism—means that further
research is required to examine whether similar approaches are effective for other abstract science concepts. In addition,
the evaluative case study design provided in-depth insights but did not allow for comparison with a control group. Future
research should consider larger samples, diverse school contexts, and comparative designs to strengthen the external
validity of these findings.
A flowchart of the research procedure is presented in Figure 1.
